review_kind: GOENV persistent-configuration counterexample and unchanged R2 build evidence

empty_process_GOFLAGS_with_persistent_GO.meaning: An empty process GOFLAGS did not suppress the persistent synthetic GOENV setting; the replacement source outside the module changed the observed dependency list.

GOENV_off_with_empty_process_GOFLAGS.meaning: Disabling the persistent Go environment removed the synthetic overlay.

nonempty_process_override.meaning: A nonempty process value overrode the synthetic persistent GOFLAGS.

fixed_r2_delivery.record_semantics: The original ARM builder records output from go env -json, rather than copying only the process GOFLAGS value.
fixed_r2_delivery.conclusion: The pinned R2 build recorded empty effective GOFLAGS, so this synthetic persisted-overlay reproduction is not evidence of overlay contamination in the delivered R2 package.
